notes: The italic with you has no morpheme behind it here and is marked added; v.16 writes אִתְּכֶם and is aligned there (rules 7, 30).

there shall be goes to the prepositional predicate לָכֶם under rules 20 and 49 rather than to the noun statute; reading חֻקָּה אַחַת as the predicate, as rule 49 reads חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם, was the competing analysis.
For the assembly is rule 33's supplied function word before a nominal carrying no preposition of its own.
